reviews.text: Doctor was fabulous! My dog was at ease! The place was local and perfect for me! They got me in for a visit quickly.

They take great care of Bentley

Love them!
Hi, Janelle. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at American Animal Hospital!

Dr. Dave took great care of my new puppies! Explained everything of what he recommends and what I need vs what we can hold off on which I really appreciated. And I’m sorry, I did not catch her name, but the lady up front was amazing! So sweet and helpful.
Hi, Heidi. Great to hear that you had a good experience at American Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
I like the vibe, I feel comfortable with my dog there.

They have taken great care of my grand doggie👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
9/2026: And now my Miss Kitty who had a skin infection.  This was her 1st visit to a Vet, & Dr. Paul and "cat whisperer", Ernie were great. Thanks so much :o)

After several neighbors began talking we realized our pets were victims here.

Wrong diagnosis
Wrong treatments

They falsely called  themselves a pet hospital / ER without the skills or supplies to treat emergencies (hence pets died).

Most folks in Mira Mesa know to avoid them.

If you happen to stumble in before reading this and suffer an avoidable loss

Please report them to the CA vetranry board

They have been sighted for false advertising and practicing outside their scope.
Highly recommend!

Everyone here is amazing! They take such good care of my cats and get me in quickly anytime I have had a concern. The vet techs have always treated my cats with so much care and kindness. One of my cats gets so stressed he potties in his carrier and they have ALWAYS cleaned him and his carrier without any hesitation. The doctors are very nice, they’re very upfront about recommendations and I trust them 100%. If you’re looking for a staff that cares and treats your pets like their own, this is the place for you.

My cats have approved this message!

I've really appreciated the care that American Animal Hospital has provided to my fur baby over the last 10 years or so. The vets themselves are caring and knowledgeable. However, the constant staff turnover has been frustrating. I feel like each time we've visited or called, it's always someone new that cannot answer questions or assist comprehensively. Additionally, the costs have gone up so much. Our established client wellness visit was $100 today. $91 basic exam fee plus $10 waste disposal fee? I asked why I was also being charged this disposal fee and was told this was for the use of the otoscope? I understand increased cost of living, inflation, etc, but already paying $91 for the exam (double what it used to be) should include any of those charges. We've been driving a pretty significant distance to get here for years because I appreciated them so much but now I'm feeling it's becoming a little more of a money grab, and there's something else going on internally that does not allow them to retain knowledgeable staff members. Additionally they will no longer send prescriptions to other pharmacies so we need to pickup a written script from them in person for my dogs daily meds. Which again for us living further away, is very inconvenient. Thank you again for the years of care, but it may be time for us to seek out another provider.
Our Maltese, Natasha, always has been taken  with great care. The entire staff is amazing.  Dr. Paul, Dr. Gil and Dr. Dave always explain in detail procedures.

My sweet baby is not user-friendly, but Dr. Gil and his assistant made me feel so comfortable that I could trust him. I am so happy to finally find a vet who loves cats. That is the most important thing to me.

Dr. Gill and staff are all very friendly and do a great job with Big Doug. We have been several times in the past year and he doesn't even put up a fight about getting out of the car, something he has done with every other vet after the first visit.  I appreciate their ability to handle my large (140lbs), poorly trained, scaredy dog. They even cut his nails without making him cry. My cat was also unphased by his visit. They are highly competent animal handlers, good vibes and all remedies have been successful.
It is very easy to book appointment with this facility at the last minute when needed. The staff are very helpful and knowledgeable. They provided all the options and explained in detail.

I took my kitten, Kiara there for first free check up as I was concerned about her post-op activity.  Dr. Dave was very thorough and patient with her. He answered all my questions and clarified all my doubts. From now on Kiara would go to AAH for any further need.

I cannot stress enough how loving and caring these professionals are with your pets. While I'm not happy with the news i was given by them, i was happy that the doctor was able to give us a straight answer for Catbug's only inevitable outcome. Even after his passing, they were able to react and send a heart warming card to relay their condolences. Not once did i ever feel like we were taken advantage of. Highly recommend.
Very helpful staff and provided great advice for my overweight nervous cat
Well that's the best care I have for my little lovies chocolate and WETA. They're awesome and so nice and so patient with my dogs
All of you at American Animal Hospital are professional, outgoing, and care very much for our 4 legged family members ❤️ Thank you for all that you do! Sincerely Karen S Meek and Biscuit🥰

I only visited this vet once, after my dog became very sick and had just come from the emergency. I was hoping to establish a place I could continue bringing him to, but before I knew it, I had to make the difficult decision to put my dog down.

I want to thank Dr. Dave and the team for sending such a thoughtful and caring card. It truly caught me off guard, and I really appreciate compassion during such a difficult time.
Took both my dog and cat in for a wellness check and they did a thorough checkup for both.   Very detailed!

On 2/2/2026, I brought in my healthy male Australian Cattle dog/German Shepherd dog mix breed (1.5 years old, 47.5 lb.) for the initial examination and got a great caring experience.  The facility is pleasant and sufficient, the employees are attentive, nice and with smile; Dr. Paul Gill, with the help of 2 assistants (one carefully held my dog to keep him steady) thoroughly examined my dog from head to tail, top to bottom, ears/eyes/teeth.

Dr. Paul Gill prescribed one and additional option of calming medications for the dog to take before his future visits, and quoted an adequate but not overwhelming vaccination and other dog cares/treatments list for me to consider.

It is a great vet visit experience worthy of the future visits.
Number 1 best vet in all of San Diego. They take excellent care of my cats. The docs wear something that help cats feel calmer. I love it here and recommend it to everyone.

I want to leave a five-star review for American Animal Hospital in the Clairemont Square (Veterinarian in San Diego, California), and especially recognize Crystal. I spoke with her recently, and she was incredibly helpful and kind.

We have three pets, all over 10 years old, and the doctors and staff have taken such wonderful care of them over the years. They truly help keep our pets healthy and thriving, and we feel so grateful for their experience and knowledge.

Everyone is always helpful, professional, and caring. Their prices are fair and reasonable, and the quality of service and customer care is exceptional.

Highly recommend American Animal Hospital!
Excellent providers and staffs .
We had an emergency with one of our kitties and they were able to get us in right away.
Clean, efficient, and pleasant facility.  Very nice and professional staff.  Gave been taking pets there for 20 years and have always had good experiences.
Hi, Stan. Great to hear that you had a good experience at American Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Alex !

Started coming here with my 3 month old puppy and now he's almost 18months. Staff are friendly and the Dr. Is a nice man who is a compassionate caregiver for my Chuy  the Boxer

Updated 12/22/25: Dr Gil Sr has decades of experience and I trust with my pets. I have had a dog now for 6 years and she's had two different procedures requiring anesthesia and I trust Dr Gil and all his 40 years of experience. His staff as always been lovely as well with the same friendly faces.

We brought our girl here as first time patients and I was very impressed! I will be back and highly recommend! Dr. Paul was informative and honest. He didn’t try to get us to agree to unnecessary tests or medication. The staff was friendly and greeted us when we first walked in even though they seemed busy. They were all so nice to our girl too! This was a wonderful first impression and I am really glad we went here. The online appointment booking is also great and makes it really easy to set an appointment and get seen asap! When my regular general vet let us down American Animal Hospital really stepped up and made sure our pup was on a path to full health!

A family run practice - Was quoted $900 for a treatment on my cane Corso that another vet quoted $4300. No fluff (literally), straight forward treatment. The office isn't super big or decorated but they serve the best purpose which is taking care of our animals without charging an arm and a leg. My family has been going to see the Dr. Gil(s)l for years. We drive from Oceanside, willingly. Thanks Dr. Gill(s)!

My dog just had a dental and wellness exam here. I was so nervous but it didn’t take too long and everything went smoothly, he was back to normal the next day. Also Dr Paul is very thorough with the exam and not rushing. The staff were very nice to us too!

The three doctors are wonderful—knowledgeable and gentle, and I am at ease after my visits. After moving to the area, I had searched for a veterinarian for my small dog with chronic GI troubles and over the years they have naturally become our reliable source of wisdom and comfort. I am truly grateful for their practice.
The staff were very nice and helpful. They provided great assistance with the documents needed to take my pet overseas.

We've taken a few pets to American Animal Hospital over the years. The doctors and staff are always professional and helpful. I have never felt that they push services that aren't needed and have always felt they take the time to clearly explain everything.

The doctor's here are the best. There is the father, Dr. Gill, we have been seeing him for 30 years. His two sons have followed in their father's footsteps and are now practicing here too. Like their father, they are wonderful at diagnostics and finding the route cause. They are all caring and gentle with our pets.
Good caring people.
Dr. Paul and the staff were great!  They helped me and my kitty through some dental work.  Very professional and though pricey because dental work is pricey it wasn't too bad. Definitely coming back.
Great customer service! Great care and love ❤️ for pets! Very gentle 😊 …

We've been taking our pug, Emerson, to the American Animal Hospital since he was 8 weeks old. He absolutely LOVES going to the vet— a stark difference from the service my other fur babies received from going to Petco/PetSmart. Dr. Dave is very thorough and listens to our input. You can tell by the way they do simple tasks (e.g. checking a dog's ears) that they actually handle our pet with care. American Animal Hospital has earned my trust, and most importantly, my pug's trust. I highly recommend them if you're in the search for a new vet.

One of our cats has a recently diagnosed serious disease. The entire staff has been exceedingly kind and helpful. The Doc has called every day to check on her condition which is very reassuring. We have never experienced such personal care before elsewhere.
Thank you American animal hospital!

Dr. Gill ( all of them :)) run an excellent vet office. They are up front on why they reccomend certain treatment plans and the costs associated. All of their staff are friendly, and they are always both gentle and efficient with my two cats.

Easy to make appointment.
Doctor gill and orher doctors are knowleable.
Reasonable price.
Highly recommend.
Hi, Calli. Great to hear that you had a good experience at American Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

Dr. Dave is amazing, and so is the entire team at American Animal Hospital!
My pup, Mia, and I recently moved here from out of state, and when she had several bouts of vomiting and diarrhea, the staff got us in quickly. They were incredibly attentive to our needs, taking the time to explain every option in detail. Dr. Dave is passionate, warm, and down-to-earth — he made us feel truly cared for. I’m so grateful to have found such a compassionate and knowledgeable team. Highly recommend!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Andre! We are delighted that you had a great experience with American Animal Hospital .

Been with them for decades! They have always been professional, not judgmental, and very informative. They advise all possible testing/scans/etc but never pressure you. They print out the estimate prices to show you to see what you would like to proceed with or hold off. They have placed many of my furbabies to sleep when it was time. Wonderful clinic!
-Todo the chipug
Very friendly staff and great care given for my dog and cat. I have been going to this clinic for more than 10 years now. I would recommend them for your pets needs.
Dr. Paul and his staff at American Animal Hospital are just great.  Everyone is friendly, caring and helpful.  My dog is always happy and excited to come in.
Hi, Ashwin. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at American Animal Hospital!
Hi, Bender. Great to hear that you had a good experience at American Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Amruta !

I have been bringing my 9yr old doggie here since 2018. I have no complaints. Everyone has always been awesome from front office staff to techs to the wonderful Dr.s. My granddog is also a patient since Feb 2024. Both dogs have been treated wonderfully. Thank you all!
Low prices, high quality. The staff cares a lot about what they do, and take their job serious. Thats why I trust them with my pets
Excellent care!

I adopted my aging sister’s 14 y/o cat who showed all the signs of poverty and neglect. Dr Paul has been treating her for almost a year and Miss Daisy has her full coat back, no more oozing scabs, confident and pleasant to be around. The doctor always calls direct, no messaging through his staff. He keeps costs down for us and always gives options. The staff is stellar! 5⭐️
Dr Gil, Dr Dave, and all the staff take great care of my dog, Rosie. The vet isn’t her favorite spot to visit but she is always happy to see the people who work there.

I took my female shepherd mix here for her first wellness check and overall first time at the vet. This is my (and my family's) first dog, so we were just as nervous about going as our dog was. She was very nervous and whining in the waiting room, but the receptionist was respectful and understanding , especially when she noticed our dog being very scared and barking at other dogs that she made sure our dog was behind the desk when another dog had to pass through.
During her examination, Dr. Dave and Carlie were very patient and calm with our clearly nervous dog. Dr. Dave read our dog's behavior and adjusted to her best he could. Both Dr. Dave and Carlie did a great job explaining things to us and making sure that our dog was well taken care of. Our dog behaved better than expected, which was partly due to the great staff at the hospital.
Thank you!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Liz !

This is my primary vet clinic for over the 3 years! This is a family owned and Professional vet. Doctors treat my babies just right and the costs are reasonable! The staffs are friendly too! Recommended!

The staff and the doctors did a good job taking care of our dog even at his last breath.

Dr Dave, Dr Paul & Dr Gill are wonderful doctors who cares for pets.

They are very honest and don’t take advantage of their clients.
Thank you for treating her so well, she is back to her normal “moxie” attitude. She was in so much pain before. Thanks again Dr Gill and all of technicians and assistants. You guys Rock! 😎 …
Excellent vet.  Very knowledgeable, professional, accommodating and caring both vet and staff.  30 years of experience is great to have taking care of your pets.

American Animal Hospital really helped me though a sad and huge decision. My cat of 14 years, Sienna, lost 3 pounds and the exam that they recommended helped make a really sad decision of euthanizing her determining that she had cancer after several tests. She was my best friend of 14 years and I appreciate this hospital and will use them for any future pets. They sent me a sympathy card as well.

Hi, Matthew. At American Animal Hospital, we aim to provide positive experiences at all times. Is there anything we could do to make it better? Please call us at (858) 586-7387 if you'd like to discuss further!

Tina, my 10 yr. old cat got very sick after having 5 teeth pulled. Dr. Paul and his caring staff pulled her through a rough 2 weeks including 4 visits (one of which he sent vet tech Debbie to pick Tina up so she could be monitored and medicated for the day. I am 92 and disabled so it is difficult for me to get her to the Vet.) Now, Tina is asking for food and lap time again. I am so grateful for the compassionate care both Tina and I received from American Animal Hospital doctors and staff.
Marcella A. Heye
The doctor got my dogs rash under control. Very nice people and helpful through the entire process. I am pleased with the outcome, service and experience with service.

We have all our dogs cared in this Veterinarian clinic and the service provided is always outstanding. Yes, they are very busy and sometimes a little waiting is needed, but they are busy for a reason! They will care very greatly of your pet!
We’ve been coming here for over 10 years with 4 different dogs and have always had good, caring service.  Highly recommend Dr. Harjot and the whole team.

We take our two French Bulldogs and my sister brings her cat here for all essential treatments and care. The American Animal Hospital is wonderful with amazing staff and Veterinarians! Highly recommend to anyone with pets.
Great service
Hi, Jeanie. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at American Animal Hospital!

My doggy was 1 when we adopted her from CV Animal Care Facility and she had 2 cherry eyes. Dr. Gil performed the surgery 3 years ago and became our regular vet. That was very important to me. I referred someone to Dr. Gil and he has also become their regular vet. Their prices are reasonable and even lower, in many instances, to other vets in Mira Mesa.

I love the care American Animal Hospital provides. They were there for Cleo, our lab, through her challenging last days and giving Cookie the care she deserves. Have consulted with Dr Dave and Dr Paul. They are great with being conservative on medication and clearly explaining all treatment options. Strongly recommend!

We love Dr. Gil, Dr Paul and his staff! The staff are very friendly and kind! I bring my  fur baby, Harley here for all his needs! Dr. Gill along with Dr Paul are very knowledgeable, & warm. Always take the time to review their findings and recommendations. We have been bringing our pets here for more than 10 years. I trust them completely with my pets. They are the best!

Very professional and very kind. Made sure I knew the cost of everything and I could deny any treatment I chose. Needed surgery for My dog and aftercare was included in price.  Am military and will work with military vets for lower costs medicine and treatment. They're really there for the animal. Thanks American Animal clinic.
We’ve been with Dr Gill over 30 years with all our dogs. There’s no one better in knowledge, guidance and compassion.
